title: Residential Hybrid Solar Inverter & Battery Installation
description: Supply and installation of an SRNE hybrid solar inverter paired with a wall-mounted lithium battery energy storage unit, giving this home clean backup power that switches in automatically during outages and can charge from solar panels during the day.

title: Home Backup Power System with Eastman Gel Battery
description: Installation of an EAE hybrid solar inverter with dedicated distribution and isolator boards, backed by an Eastman deep-cycle gel battery, delivering seamless backup power for lighting and essential circuits during grid outages.

title: Rooftop Solar Water Heater Installation
description: Supply and rooftop installation of a vacuum-tube solar water heater, giving this household reliable hot water straight from the sun and cutting their monthly electricity costs.

title: Automatic Transfer Switch Control Panel
description: Design and installation of a custom control panel with automatic transfer switching between mains and standby power, complete with clear UPS/mains status indicators and full electrical safety signage.
